0.name: Digit 0
0.description: Fingers curled touching thumb forming an oval '0'.
0.tips: Curl all fingers so fingertips meet thumb tip in a zero shape.

1.name: Digit 1
1.description: Single index finger extended upright, other fingers curled.

2.name: Digit 2
2.description: Index and middle fingers extended upright together or slightly spread.

3.name: Digit 3
3.description: Index, middle, and ring fingers extended upright.
3.tips: Raise index, middle, and ring fingers.

4.name: Digit 4
4.description: Four fingers (index, middle, ring, pinky) extended, thumb folded across palm.
4.tips: Four fingers held up, thumb tucked inward.

5.name: Digit 5
5.description: All five fingers fully spread and extended open.
5.tips: Open hand with all five fingers spread apart.

6.name: Digit 6
6.description: Left hand open with 5 fingers; right hand extends 1 index finger (5 + 1 = 6).
6.tips: Left hand shows 5, right hand shows 1 beside it.

7.name: Digit 7
7.description: Left hand open with 5 fingers; right hand extends 2 fingers (5 + 2 = 7).
7.tips: Left hand shows 5, right hand shows 2.

8.name: Digit 8
8.description: Left hand open with 5 fingers; right hand extends 3 fingers (5 + 3 = 8).
8.tips: Left hand shows 5, right hand shows 3.

9.name: Digit 9
9.description: Left hand open with 5 fingers; right hand extends 4 fingers (5 + 4 = 9).
9.tips: Left hand shows 5, right hand shows 4.

A.name: Letter A
A.description: Left hand open palm facing right; right hand index finger touches the tip of left thumb.
A.tips: Touch the right index fingertip to the left thumb tip while keeping left fingers spread.

B.name: Letter B
B.description: Left hand open upright; right hand index and middle finger form a loop against left palm/thumb.
B.tips: Both hands form two loops resembling the letter 'B'.

C.name: Letter C
C.description: Curved hand forming a 'C' shape with thumb and four fingers.
C.tips: Single hand held sideways, fingers and thumb curved like the letter C.

D.name: Letter D
D.description: Left hand index pointing up; right hand curved into 'C' touching left index to form 'D'.
D.tips: Left index finger is the vertical stem; right curved hand creates the curved back of D.

E.name: Letter E
E.description: Left hand open palm; right hand index finger touches left index fingertip.
E.tips: Right index touches the tip of the left index finger (representing vowel E).

F.name: Letter F
F.description: Left index and middle finger horizontal; right index and middle finger placed across them.
F.tips: Cross two fingers of right hand over two horizontal fingers of left hand.

G.name: Letter G
G.description: Both hands form closed fists placed one on top of the other.
G.tips: Right fist rested directly atop left fist.

H.name: Letter H
H.description: Left hand flat palm horizontal; right hand flat palm swept across left palm.
H.tips: Right flat palm sweeps across the horizontal left palm.

HELLO.name: Hello / Namaste
HELLO.description: Open flat hand salutes outward from temple, or palms together in Namaste.
HELLO.tips: Salute outward from brow or press palms in Namaste.

HELP.name: Help / Support
HELP.description: Dominant thumbs-up fist sits atop non-dominant flat palm and lifts up.
HELP.tips: Lift thumbs-up fist with open palm underneath.

I.name: Letter I
I.description: Left hand open palm facing inward; right hand index finger touches left middle fingertip.
I.tips: Right index touches the tip of the left middle finger (representing vowel I).

J.name: Letter J
J.description: Right index traces the letter 'J' starting from left middle fingertip down and curling up.
J.tips: Start at left middle fingertip, trace down into left palm with a hook.

K.name: Letter K
K.description: Left index pointing up; right index finger bent at knuckle hooked onto left index.
K.tips: Right bent index finger hooks around the vertical left index finger.

L.name: Letter L
L.description: Single hand with thumb and index finger extended at right angles forming an 'L'.
L.tips: Hold right hand up, thumb horizontal and index pointing straight up.

M.name: Letter M
M.description: Right hand places three fingers (index, middle, ring) on the flat palm of left hand.
M.tips: Three fingertips of right hand rest on left open palm to represent three legs of M.

N.name: Letter N
N.description: Right hand places two fingers (index and middle) on the flat palm of left hand.
N.tips: Two fingertips of right hand rest on left open palm to represent two legs of N.

NO.name: No / Deny
NO.description: Index and middle finger snap closed against thumb tip.
NO.tips: Snap index and middle down onto thumb firmly.

O.name: Letter O
O.description: Left hand open palm; right index touches the tip of left ring finger (vowel O).
O.tips: Right index touches left ring fingertip (representing vowel O).

P.name: Letter P
P.description: Left hand index pointing up; right hand thumb and index form a small circle at the top.
P.tips: Left index forms stem; right thumb-index loop attaches to top to form P.

PLEASE.name: Please
PLEASE.description: Flat open hand rubbed in a circular motion over the chest.
PLEASE.tips: Rub flat palm clockwise on center of chest.

Q.name: Letter Q
Q.description: Left hand thumb and index form circle 'O'; right hand index placed through bottom as the tail.
Q.tips: Left hand circle with right index finger protruding down diagonally.

R.name: Letter R
R.description: Left hand flat; right hand index finger hooked like a shepherd's crook resting on left palm.
R.tips: Right curved/hooked index rests gently on the open left palm.

S.name: Letter S
S.description: Both pinky fingers hooked together with fists closed.
S.tips: Interlock both little (pinky) fingers while keeping palms facing you.

T.name: Letter T
T.description: Left hand index pointing right horizontally; right hand index touches midpoint from below forming 'T'.
T.tips: Left index is the horizontal bar; right index is the vertical stem touching the midpoint.

THANK_YOU.name: Thank You / Grateful
THANK_YOU.description: Fingertips touch chin/lips and move forward towards listener with flat palm.
THANK_YOU.tips: Touch fingertips to chin and extend open palm outward with gratitude.

U.name: Letter U
U.description: Left hand open palm; right hand index touches the tip of left pinky finger (vowel U).
U.tips: Right index touches left pinky fingertip (representing vowel U).

V.name: Letter V
V.description: Single hand index and middle fingers extended apart in a 'V' shape (peace sign).
V.tips: Extend index and middle fingers apart while thumb holds ring and pinky.

W.name: Letter W
W.description: Fingers of both hands interlocked and pointed upwards forming a 'W' shape.
W.tips: Interlock all fingers of both hands pointing upwards.

X.name: Letter X
X.description: Both index fingers crossed over each other to form an 'X'.
X.tips: Cross right index over left index at 90 degrees.

Y.name: Letter Y
Y.description: Left index and thumb extended in 'V'; right index rests in the junction pointing down.
Y.tips: Right index finger points between the left extended thumb and index finger.

YES.name: Yes / Affirm
YES.description: 'S' fist nods up and down like a head nodding yes.
YES.tips: Nod closed fist up and down gently.

Z.name: Letter Z
Z.description: Left hand held flat horizontally; right hand held vertical with fingertips touching to form angle of Z.
Z.tips: Right fingertips touch left palm or right index traces 'Z' in the air.
